domains.name: fabrication
domains.description: Core wafer fabrication and processing domain governing all FAB operations including FEOL, MOL, and BEOL process steps. Owns wafer lot tracking, WIP management, process recipe execution, and fab line scheduling across CVD, PVD, ALD, CMP, ion implantation, and EUV/DUV lithography operations. Authoritative source for wafer genealogy and lot disposition via MES integration.

products.name: fabrication_wafer_lot
products.description: Core master entity representing a wafer lot (batch of wafers) tracked through the FAB from wafer start to lot disposition. Authoritative source for lot identity, wafer count, lot type (production, engineering, qualification, MPW), process node, technology node, product code, priority class, WIP status, hold flags, and genealogy linkage. Sourced from Camstar MES and Applied Materials SmartFactory MES. SSOT for all WIP lot tracking across FEOL, MOL, and BEOL operations. Quality and metrology data for this lot is owned by the quality domain and referenced via cross-domain FK.
products.reference: Camstar MES Lot Master / SEMI E10

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the wafer lot tracked through the FAB from wafer start to lot disposition. Primary key for all WIP lot tracking across FEOL, MOL, and BEOL operations.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Required for lot‑level billing and customer account reporting; each wafer lot is charged to a specific customer account.

attributes.name: booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.booking. Business justification: Fab planners prioritize and track wafer lots against confirmed customer bookings for on-time delivery reporting and revenue recognition. A booking is the confirmed demand event that a hot lot or prior

attributes.name: control_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.control_plan. Business justification: A wafer lot is processed under a specific control plan version active at production time. IATF 16949 and customer quality agreements require lot-to-control-plan traceability for quality audits and cus

attributes.name: customer_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.customer_contract. Business justification: Wafer lots manufactured under long-term supply agreements (LTSAs) must reference the governing customer contract to validate volume commitments, technology node compliance, and PCN obligations. Fab op

attributes.name: fab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.fab_facility. Business justification: A wafer lot is processed at a specific fab facility. fabrication_wafer_lot currently stores fab_facility_code as a denormalized string with no FK to fab_facility. Adding fab_facility_id normalizes thi

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Required for Production Planning Report linking each wafer lot to the specific IC catalog item being manufactured.

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.ic_design_project. Business justification: Required for lot‑level cost and yield reporting per design project, enabling profitability analysis and project KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: parent_lot_fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent lot from which this lot was split or derived. Null for original lots. Enables wafer genealogy tracking and traceability.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process route (recipe sequence) assigned to this lot. Defines the complete sequence of operations from wafer start to completion.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Production planning and order fulfillment track wafer lots against specific SKUs (speed grade, voltage, temperature bin) to calculate commit quantities and manage process splits. Semiconductor fabs re

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.tapeout. Business justification: A wafer lot is produced from a specific tapeout's mask set. Foundry production tracking links lots to tapeouts for mask set identification, NRE billing, re-spin management, and export control complian

attributes.name: technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.technology_node. Business justification: Wafer lot references a technology node; replace string column with FK to technology_node for normalization.

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot completed all FAB processing operations and was dispositioned. Null for lots still in WIP.

attributes.name: current_operation_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the current process operation (e.g., CVD_OXIDE_DEP, EUV_LITHO, CMP_POLISH). Provides human-readable context for lot location.

attributes.name: current_operation_number
attributes.description: Sequential operation step number in the process route where the lot is currently located. Used for tracking lot position in the manufacturing flow.

attributes.name: current_process_area
attributes.description: High-level FAB area classification where the lot is currently located: FEOL (front-end-of-line transistor formation), MOL (middle-of-line contacts), BEOL (back-end-of-line interconnect), metrology (inspection), or test (electrical probe).

attributes.name: cycle_time_days
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in days from wafer start to lot completion. Key performance metric for manufacturing efficiency and customer responsiveness.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the lot to meet customer delivery commitments. Used for scheduling and on-time-delivery tracking.

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lot is currently on hold and prevented from processing. True when lot is held for quality, engineering, or disposition review.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for lot hold (e.g., QUAL_FAIL, ENG_REVIEW, EQUIP_DOWN, MATL_ISSUE). Null when hold_flag is false.

attributes.name: hold_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot was placed on hold. Used to calculate hold duration and impact on cycle time. Null when lot is not on hold.

attributes.name: initial_wafer_count
attributes.description: Original number of wafers when the lot was started. Used to calculate yield loss and scrap rate during processing.

attributes.name: is_hot_lot
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is designated as a hot lot requiring expedited processing and priority resource allocation. True for urgent customer orders.

attributes.name: lot_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot record was first created in the MES system. May precede wafer start for planning purposes.

attributes.name: lot_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the completed lot: pass (released to next stage), fail (rejected), partial (some wafers pass), rework (reprocess), scrap (discard), or engineering_hold (pending review).

attributes.name: lot_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operators and engineers to record important observations, special handling instructions, or process deviations for this lot.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the wafer lot assigned by MES at wafer start. Used for tracking and traceability across all FAB operations and external communications.

attributes.name: lot_on_node
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.technology_node.technology_node_id — Every lot is manufactured on a specific technology node. This is fundamental for WIP classification and routing.

attributes.name: lot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wafer lot purpose: production (revenue-generating), engineering (process development), qualification (product validation), MPW (multi-project wafer shuttle), pilot (pre-production), or rework (reprocessed lot).

attributes.name: lot_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot record was last modified in the MES system. Tracks most recent status or attribute change.

attributes.name: mes_system_source
attributes.description: Identifies the source MES system that created and manages this lot record: Camstar MES, Applied Materials SmartFactory MES, or other. Used for data lineage and system integration.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Forecasted completion date based on current WIP position, remaining operations, and standard cycle times. Updated dynamically as lot progresses.

attributes.name: priority_class
attributes.description: Scheduling priority assigned to the lot for FAB resource allocation. Hot and expedite lots receive preferential processing to meet urgent customer commitments.

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Technology node of the semiconductor process measured in nanometers (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm). Defines the minimum feature size and process complexity.

attributes.name: process_time_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative time in hours the lot has spent in active processing on equipment. Excludes queue and hold time. Used for capacity planning.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the IC product being manufactured. Used for reporting and customer communications.

attributes.name: queue_time_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative time in hours the lot has spent waiting in queue between operations. Excludes active processing time. Used to identify bottlenecks.

attributes.name: rework_count
attributes.description: Number of times the lot has been reworked or reprocessed through specific operations. Tracks process stability and quality issues.

attributes.name: route_version
attributes.description: Version number of the process route. Tracks recipe changes and process improvements over time for traceability and yield analysis.

attributes.name: sampling_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the quality sampling and inspection plan applied to this lot. Defines which wafers are sampled and at which operations for metrology and defect inspection.

attributes.name: scrap_wafer_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafers scrapped during processing due to defects, breakage, or sampling. Used to calculate yield loss and process capability.

attributes.name: split_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned when a lot is split into multiple child lots. Used with parent_lot_id to track lot genealogy and wafer provenance.

attributes.name: wafer_count
attributes.description: Current number of wafers in the lot. May decrease due to scraps, breakage, or sampling during processing. Initial count typically 25 wafers per lot for standard production.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the silicon wafers in the lot measured in millimeters. Standard sizes include 200mm (8-inch) and 300mm (12-inch).

attributes.name: wafer_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wafer lot was officially started in the FAB and entered WIP tracking. Represents the beginning of the lot's manufacturing lifecycle.

attributes.name: wip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wafer lot in the FAB workflow. Tracks lot progression from queue through processing to final disposition.

products.name: wafer
products.description: Individual silicon wafer entity within a lot, tracking wafer number, substrate type, diameter, orientation, resistivity, epitaxial layer specs, and current disposition. Enables per-wafer genealogy and yield tracking across all FAB process steps. Sourced from Camstar MES wafer tracking module.
products.reference: Camstar MES Wafer Record / SEMI M1

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual silicon wafer within the fabrication facility. Primary key for wafer tracking across all FAB (Fabrication Facility) process steps.

attributes.name: fab_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication facility where this wafer is being processed. Supports multi-site operations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent wafer lot that this wafer belongs to. Wafers are processed in lots through the FAB (Fabrication Facility).

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IC (Integrated Circuit) design project that this wafer is fabricating. Links to design specifications, GDS (Graphic Data System) files, and tapeout records.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Individual wafer substrate traceability to the procured material master is required for RoHS/REACH compliance reporting, yield-by-material-source analysis, and semiconductor quality management. A fab

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process route or recipe that defines the sequence of fabrication steps for this wafer. Routes vary by product technology node and design.

attributes.name: technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.technology_node. Business justification: Wafer references a technology node; add FK to technology_node and remove numeric node column.

attributes.name: belongs_to_lot
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.fabrication_wafer_lot.fabrication_wafer_lot_id — Every wafer must reference its parent lot. This is the most fundamental relationship in FAB WIP tracking - wafers are always tracked within the context of their lot.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the wafer completed all FAB (Fabrication Facility) process steps and is ready for wafer probing or shipment to OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test). Null for in-process wafers.

attributes.name: critical_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of critical defects that are likely to cause die failure. Subset of total defect count, used for yield prediction and SPC (Statistical Process Control).

attributes.name: crystal_orientation
attributes.description: Crystallographic orientation of the silicon wafer surface, specified using Miller indices. <100> is most common for CMOS (Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor) fabrication.

attributes.name: current_operation_number
attributes.description: Sequential operation number in the process route that the wafer is currently at. Used for tracking progress through the hundreds of steps in IC (Integrated Circuit) fabrication.

attributes.name: current_process_step
attributes.description: Name or code of the current fabrication process step the wafer is at or has completed. Examples: lithography, CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition), CMP (Chemical Mechanical Planarization), ion implantation.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects detected on the wafer surface through inspection systems. Tracked across process steps to monitor yield and process control.

attributes.name: diameter_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the wafer in millimeters. Standard sizes include 150mm (6 inch), 200mm (8 inch), and 300mm (12 inch). Larger diameters enable more dies per wafer.

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the wafer in the FAB (Fabrication Facility) workflow. Tracks lifecycle state from WIP (Work in Process) through completion or scrap.

attributes.name: doping_type
attributes.description: Electrical doping type of the substrate. P-type (boron-doped) or N-type (phosphorus/arsenic-doped) determines the majority carrier type. Intrinsic wafers are undoped.

attributes.name: epitaxial_layer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wafer has an epitaxial layer grown on the substrate. Epitaxial wafers have a thin crystalline layer with controlled properties for advanced device fabrication.

attributes.name: epitaxial_resistivity_ohm_cm
attributes.description: Electrical resistivity of the epitaxial layer in ohm-centimeters, if present. Null for non-epitaxial wafers. Often differs from substrate resistivity.

attributes.name: epitaxial_thickness_um
attributes.description: Thickness of the epitaxial layer in micrometers, if present. Null for non-epitaxial wafers. Typical range: 1-20 micrometers.

attributes.name: expected_die_count
attributes.description: Expected number of dies (individual chips) on this wafer based on die size and wafer diameter. Used for yield calculation and planning.

attributes.name: genealogy_path
attributes.description: Hierarchical path tracking the wafer lineage from ingot to lot to wafer. Enables traceability for quality investigations and compliance. Format varies by MES (Manufacturing Execution System).

attributes.name: good_die_count
attributes.description: Actual number of dies that passed electrical testing and quality inspection. Populated after wafer probing and testing. Used to calculate wafer yield.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for wafer hold or quarantine, if applicable. Examples: out-of-spec measurement, equipment issue, quality investigation. Null for non-held wafers.

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent defect inspection or metrology measurement performed on this wafer. Null if no inspection has been performed yet.

attributes.name: last_process_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent process step or operation performed on this wafer. Used for WIP (Work in Process) tracking and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: notch_orientation_degrees
attributes.description: Angular position of the wafer notch in degrees, used for wafer alignment and orientation during automated processing. Standard is 0 degrees for <110> direction.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Processing priority level for this wafer. Critical and high priority wafers receive expedited processing to meet customer commitments or TTM (Time to Market) requirements.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wafer record was first created in the data system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wafer record was last updated in the data system. Audit field for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: resistivity_ohm_cm
attributes.description: Electrical resistivity of the wafer substrate in ohm-centimeters. Indicates doping concentration and electrical properties. Typical range: 0.001 to 100+ ohm-cm.

attributes.name: rework_count
attributes.description: Number of times this wafer has been reworked or reprocessed due to process excursions or quality issues. Tracked for yield analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for wafer scrap, if applicable. Examples: excessive defects, process excursion, handling damage, contamination. Null for non-scrapped wafers.

attributes.name: slot_position
attributes.description: Physical slot position of the wafer within the carrier or cassette during processing. Used for tracking and automation.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the wafer entered the FAB (Fabrication Facility) and began processing. Marks the beginning of the wafer lifecycle for cycle time tracking.

attributes.name: substrate_type
attributes.description: Material composition of the wafer substrate. Silicon is most common, but compound semiconductors like GaAs (Gallium Arsenide), SiC (Silicon Carbide), and GaN (Gallium Nitride) are used for specialized applications.

attributes.name: thickness_um
attributes.description: Thickness of the wafer in micrometers. Typical range is 500-800 micrometers depending on diameter and application. Critical for mechanical stability and process control.

attributes.name: wafer_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the wafer within its lot. Typically a sequential number or alphanumeric code assigned during lot creation.

products.name: process_recipe
products.description: Master record for a validated process recipe defining the exact sequence of process parameters, tool settings, gas flows, temperatures, pressures, and timing for a specific FAB operation (CVD, PVD, ALD, CMP, implant, etch, lithography). Includes recipe version history, approval status, change control reference, qualification status, and effective date range. Versioning managed within this entity via version number and effective dates. Sourced from Applied Materials SmartFactory MES recipe management and integrated with engineering change order workflow.
products.reference: SmartFactory MES Recipe Master / SEMI E10

attributes.name: process_recipe_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fabrication process recipe. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approved_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.approved_vendor. Business justification: Semiconductor process recipes are qualified against materials from specific approved vendors. This link enables process qualification scope management — when an approved vendor status changes or expir

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Process recipes specify qualified consumable materials (deposition targets, etch gases, CMP slurries). Linking recipe to material_master enables PCN impact analysis — when a supplier changes a materia

attributes.name: technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.fabrication_technology_node. Business justification: A process recipe is validated and qualified for a specific technology node (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm). fabrication_process_recipe currently stores process_node_nm as a denormalized integer with no FK to f

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the recipe was formally approved for production use.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Engineering approval status indicating whether the recipe has been reviewed and authorized for use by process engineering and quality teams.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the process engineer or quality manager who approved this recipe for production use.

attributes.name: chamber_configuration
attributes.description: Specific chamber or module configuration within the equipment where the recipe is executed, enabling multi-chamber tool recipe management.

attributes.name: change_control_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Product Change Notification (PCN) that authorized the creation or modification of this recipe.

attributes.name: cool_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Specified cooling duration.

attributes.name: cool_target_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Target cooldown temperature in recipe.

attributes.name: coolant_flow_rate_lpm
attributes.description: Coolant flow rate in liters per minute.

attributes.name: coolant_recirculation_flag
attributes.description: Whether coolant is recirculated to reduce waste.

attributes.name: coolant_reclaim_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of coolant reclaimed/recycled.

attributes.name: coolant_recycling_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Whether coolant recycling (waste elimination) is enabled.

attributes.name: coolant_waste_volume_liters
attributes.description: Volume of coolant waste generated.

attributes.name: cooldown_rate_celsius_per_min
attributes.description: Specified cooldown rate.

attributes.name: cooling_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the cooling stage.

attributes.name: cooling_energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumed by the cooling process.

attributes.name: cooling_energy_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Whether waste-heat / energy recovery is enabled for the recipe cooling step.

attributes.name: cooling_energy_target_kwh
attributes.description: Target cooling energy consumption.

attributes.name: cooling_medium
attributes.description: Cooling medium used (e.g., DI water, helium backside, chilled nitrogen).

attributes.name: cooling_method
attributes.description: Cooling method defined by the recipe.

attributes.name: cooling_optimization_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Whether cooling optimization is enabled for this step/recipe.

attributes.name: cooling_optimization_mode
attributes.description: Cooling optimization option for the recipe.

attributes.name: cooling_optimization_option
attributes.description: Cooling optimization option applied during the recipe cooling step.

attributes.name: cooling_process_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this step/recipe includes a cooling process stage.

attributes.name: cooling_ramp_rate_celsius_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cooling Ramp Rate Celsius Per Min
attributes.description: Controlled cooling ramp-down rate.

tag_set.value: Cooling Ramp Rate Celsius Per Min

attributes.name: cooling_step_required_flag
attributes.description: Whether the recipe includes a cooling step.

attributes.name: cooling_target_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Target wafer/chamber temperature after cooling.

attributes.name: cooling_waste_elimination_option
attributes.description: Waste-elimination option applied during the recipe cooling step.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recipe record was first created in the MES system.

attributes.name: defect_density_target_per_cm2
attributes.description: Target defect density in defects per square centimeter for wafers processed with this recipe, critical for yield management.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this recipe version is superseded or retired. Null indicates the recipe is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this recipe version becomes effective and available for production use.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this recipe complies with environmental regulations including RoHS, REACH, and TSCA for chemical usage and emissions.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type or model of fabrication equipment (tool) for which this recipe is designed, such as Applied Materials Centura, Lam Research Flex, or ASML NXT scanner.

attributes.name: fmea_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) document that identifies potential failure modes and mitigation strategies for this recipe.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference

attributes.name: gas_flow_parameters
attributes.description: Detailed gas flow settings including gas types, flow rates (sccm), and ratios for CVD, PVD, ALD, and etch processes. Stored as structured text or JSON.

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this recipe is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) export control restrictions.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recipe record was last modified, supporting change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: power_settings_watts
attributes.description: RF or DC power settings in watts for plasma-based processes such as PVD, etch, and plasma-enhanced CVD.

attributes.name: process_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration in seconds for the recipe execution from start to completion.

attributes.name: process_layer_type
attributes.description: Fabrication layer classification: Front End of Line (FEOL) for transistor formation, Middle of Line (MOL) for contacts, or Back End of Line (BEOL) for interconnects.

attributes.name: process_operation_type
attributes.description: Type of FAB operation this recipe defines: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD), Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP), etch, lithography (EUV/DUV), ion implantation, diffusion, oxidation, annealing, or cleaning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CVD|PVD|ALD|CMP|etch|lithography|ion_implantation|diffusion|oxidation|annealing|cleaning — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: process_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Target chamber pressure in Torr for the recipe execution, critical for CVD, PVD, and ALD processes.

attributes.name: process_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Target process temperature in degrees Celsius for the recipe execution.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: Product family or IC design family for which this recipe is optimized (e.g., mobile processors, automotive chips, AI accelerators).

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the recipe successfully completed qualification testing and was certified for production.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Qualification state indicating whether the recipe has passed validation testing and is certified for production use.

attributes.name: recipe_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the recipe for system identification and traceability across MES and ERP systems.

attributes.name: recipe_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the recipes purpose, process objectives, and special considerations for operators and engineers.

attributes.name: recipe_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the process recipe used for identification and reference by FAB operators and process engineers.

attributes.name: recipe_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recipe: draft (under development), under_review (pending approval), approved (validated but not yet active), active (in production use), suspended (temporarily disabled), or obsolete (retired).

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the recipe enabling change control and traceability of recipe evolution over time.

attributes.name: requalification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the recipe must be requalified to remain in active production status, per quality management requirements.

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: Safety classification indicating special handling requirements: standard, hazardous_material, high_temperature, high_pressure, or toxic_gas.

attributes.name: spc_control_plan_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Statistical Process Control (SPC) plan that monitors this recipes performance and detects process drift.

tag_set.value: Statistical Process Control (SPC) Control Plan Reference

attributes.name: step_sequence_definition
attributes.description: Ordered sequence of process steps within the recipe, including step names, durations, and parameter transitions. Stored as structured text or JSON.

attributes.name: target_material
attributes.description: Material being deposited, etched, or processed by this recipe (e.g., silicon dioxide, tungsten, copper, photoresist, low-k dielectric).

attributes.name: target_thickness_nm
attributes.description: Target thickness in nanometers for deposition or remaining thickness after etch/CMP operations.

attributes.name: uniformity_target_percent
attributes.description: Target uniformity percentage for thickness, composition, or other critical parameters across the wafer surface.

attributes.name: waste_elimination_strategy
attributes.description: Waste elimination strategy (e.g., heat_recovery, coolant_reclaim, lean_idle_shutdown).

attributes.name: waste_heat_recovery_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Whether waste-heat recovery is enabled.

attributes.name: waste_heat_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Whether waste heat is recovered/reused.

attributes.name: yield_target_percent
attributes.description: Target yield percentage for wafers processed using this recipe, used for performance monitoring and continuous improvement.

products.name: process_step
products.description: Individual process step definition within a process flow routing, specifying step sequence number, operation type (FEOL/MOL/BEOL), process category (lithography, etch, deposition, CMP, implant, anneal, clean, wet clean), target recipe reference, equipment class constraint, SPC control plan linkage, rework loop indicators, and step-level cycle time targets. Forms the authoritative step catalog for all FAB routing and is the granular unit of WIP tracking. Aligned with SEMI E40 process management standard for step-level definition.
products.reference: MES Process Step / SEMI E10 Process Flow

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process step within the FAB routing. Primary key for the process step entity.

attributes.name: control_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.control_plan. Business justification: Each fabrication process step is governed by a control plan specifying inspection frequency, measurement criteria, and acceptance limits. IATF 16949 mandates explicit traceability from process steps t

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent process flow routing that contains this step. Links the step to its overall manufacturing route.

attributes.name: process_recipe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the target process recipe that defines the detailed parameters, settings, and control logic for executing this step on the equipment.

attributes.name: rework_return_to_step_process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the target process step to which lots are routed when rework is triggered from this step. Null if no rework loop exists.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the process step was approved for production use. Used for change control and audit trails.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the process step definition. Tracks engineering change control and qualification approval.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer or manager who approved this process step for production use. Used for traceability and accountability.

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: Number of wafers or lots that can be processed together in a single batch at this step. Null for single-wafer processing steps.

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: Engineering change order or change control number associated with the creation or modification of this process step. Links to formal change management process.

attributes.name: coolant_flow_rate_lpm
attributes.description: Coolant flow rate in liters per minute.

attributes.name: coolant_recirculation_flag

attributes.name: doping_type

attributes.name: estimated_cycle_time_days

attributes.name: hold_reason_code

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag

attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this wafer lot contains ITAR-controlled technology requiring export compliance controls. True if ITAR applies; False otherwise.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this wafer start record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot identifier assigned to the wafer batch at start. This is the primary tracking identifier throughout FAB operations.

attributes.name: nre_project_code
attributes.description: Reference to the NRE project if this wafer start is part of a customer-funded development program. Used for cost tracking and milestone billing.

attributes.name: parent_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number of the parent lot if this wafer start is a split or rework from an existing lot. Null for original starts. Enables wafer genealogy tracking.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date for completing all FAB processing steps and releasing the lot to wafer test. Based on standard cycle time for the process flow.

attributes.name: priority_class
attributes.description: Scheduling priority for this wafer lot in the FAB line. Hot lots receive expedited processing; engineering lots may have flexible timing; standard and low follow normal queue discipline.

attributes.name: production_line
attributes.description: Specific production line or bay within the FAB facility assigned to this wafer start. Determines equipment set and process capability.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wafer lot was physically released into the FAB line and began processing. Marks the start of cycle time measurement.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested delivery date for finished wafers or packaged units. Drives priority and scheduling decisions.

attributes.name: resistivity_ohm_cm
attributes.description: Electrical resistivity of the starting wafer substrate, measured in ohm-centimeters. Indicates doping concentration and electrical characteristics.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for any special handling instructions, process deviations, or notes that operators and engineers should be aware of for this wafer lot.

attributes.name: split_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this lot was split from a parent lot, if applicable. Examples: process experiment, capacity balancing, quality segregation.

attributes.name: substrate_type
attributes.description: Type of semiconductor substrate material used for this wafer lot. Silicon is standard; SOI (Silicon on Insulator), GaAs (Gallium Arsenide), GaN (Gallium Nitride), and SiC (Silicon Carbide) are specialty materials.

attributes.name: wafer_quantity
attributes.description: Number of wafers authorized and started in this lot. Represents the initial wafer count at FAB entry before any processing losses.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the silicon wafer in millimeters. Standard values are 200mm or 300mm. Determines compatible equipment and process chambers.

attributes.name: wafer_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the wafer lot was authorized and initiated into the FAB line. Principal business event timestamp for capacity planning and WIP tracking.

attributes.name: wafer_start_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the wafer start transaction, externally visible and used for tracking and reporting. Format: WS followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: wafer_start_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wafer start transaction. Authorized: approved but not yet released; Released: entered FAB line; In Process: active WIP; Completed: all steps finished; Cancelled: terminated before completion; On Hold: temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: wafer_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the wafer lot was released into the FAB line, including time zone. Used for detailed cycle time analysis and shift-level tracking.

attributes.name: wafer_start_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wafer start purpose: production (customer orders), engineering (process development), qualification (product validation), MPW (multi-project wafer), pilot (pre-production), or rework (reprocessing).

attributes.name: work_center
attributes.description: SAP work center code representing the initial processing area for this wafer start. Used for capacity planning and cost allocation.

attributes.description: Indicator whether management or engineering approval is required before the hold can be released.

attributes.description: Duration in hours between hold placement and release, used for cycle time tracking and excursion management KPIs.

attributes.name: hold_expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold automatically expires if not explicitly released or extended, used for time-bound holds.

attributes.name: hold_placement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hold was placed on the lot, representing the principal business event timestamp.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for placing the lot on hold (e.g., process excursion, quality issue, engineering investigation, customer request).

attributes.name: hold_reason_description

attributes.name: hold_status

SSOT for mask inventory, lithography step qualification, and reticle lifecycle management within the FAB.
products.reference: SEMI P1 / SEMI P10 Mask Standard

attributes.description: Primary key for photomask

Proper FK normalizes the existing storage_location_code plain-text col

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.fabrication_technology_node. attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total cost paid to acquire this photomask including mask fabrication, OPC, inspection, and shipping. Denominated in USD. Used for asset valuation and depreciation.

attributes.name: cd_uniformity_specification
attributes.description: Maximum allowed CD variation across the mask field in nanometers (3-sigma). Tighter specifications required for advanced nodes. Typical range 1-5nm.

attributes.name: cleaning_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of times this mask has undergone wet or dry cleaning to remove particles and contamination. Excessive cleaning can damage mask patterns.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this photomask record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: critical_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of critical (killer) defects that will print on wafer and cause yield loss. Subset of total defect count. Mask must be retired or repaired when this exceeds threshold.

attributes.name: critical_dimension_target_nm
attributes.description: Target critical dimension (minimum feature size) for this mask layer in nanometers. Used to verify mask pattern fidelity and wafer print quality.

attributes.name: cumulative_exposure_hours
attributes.description: Total hours this mask has been exposed to lithography light source (EUV or DUV). Tracks photochemical degradation and pellicle aging.

attributes.name: cumulative_usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafer exposures performed with this mask since first use. Primary metric for mask wear tracking and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: defect_count_last_inspection
attributes.description: Number of defects detected during the most recent mask inspection. Tracked to monitor mask degradation and determine cleaning or retirement needs.

attributes.name: defect_retirement_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum critical defect count allowed before mask must be retired or sent for repair. Typically 1-5 defects depending on technology node and layer criticality.

attributes.name: gds_file_checksum
attributes.description: MD5 or SHA-256 checksum of the GDSII file used to generate this mask. Ensures mask-to-design traceability and detects unauthorized pattern changes.

attributes.name: last_cleaning_date
attributes.description: Date when the mask was last cleaned. Used to schedule preventive cleaning and correlate defect growth with cleaning intervals.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent mask inspection performed by KLA or equivalent metrology tool. Used to enforce periodic inspection schedules.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this photomask record was last updated. Tracks data currency and supports change auditing.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Process layer designation for which this photomask is used (e.g., POLY, METAL1, VIA2, CONTACT). Corresponds to the GDS layer in the design database.

attributes.name: lithography_wavelength
attributes.description: Exposure wavelength for which this mask is optimized: EUV (13.5nm), DUV ArF (193nm), DUV KrF (248nm), or i-line (365nm).

attributes.name: mask_generation
attributes.description: Generation number of this mask within the mask set. Incremented when a mask is replaced due to defects, pattern revisions, or wear-out. Generation 1 is the original mask.

attributes.name: mask_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the mask shop vendor for traceability and warranty purposes. Engraved on the reticle substrate.

attributes.name: mask_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the photomask: qualified (ready for production), in production (actively used), in inspection, in cleaning, in repair, quarantined (defect investigation), retired (end of life), or scrapped (disposed). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: qualified|in_production|in_inspection|in_cleaning|in_repair|quarantined|retired|scrapped — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: mask_type
attributes.description: Classification of photomask technology: binary (chrome on glass), attenuated phase shift mask (PSM), alternating PSM, EUV with pellicle, EUV without pellicle, or OPC-enhanced mask.

attributes.name: meef_value
attributes.description: Mask Error Enhancement Factor quantifying how mask pattern errors are amplified on the wafer. Higher MEEF indicates greater sensitivity to mask defects. Typical range 1.0 to 8.0.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory mask inspection. Calculated based on usage count, exposure hours, or calendar interval per mask management policy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording mask-specific observations, special handling instructions, repair history, or other contextual information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: opc_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the OPC software and recipe used to generate the mask pattern. Critical for mask-to-mask consistency and reticle enhancement technology tracking.

attributes.name: pellicle_installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the current pellicle was installed on the mask. Used to track pellicle aging and replacement cycles.

attributes.name: pellicle_status
attributes.description: Current status of the protective pellicle membrane: installed (protecting mask surface), removed (for inspection or repair), damaged (requires replacement), or not applicable (EUV masks without pellicle).

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the mask passed final qualification inspection and was approved for production use. Marks the start of the masks production lifecycle.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the mask was received from the vendor and logged into the FAB inventory system. Marks the start of the masks asset lifecycle.

attributes.name: registration_error_specification_nm
attributes.description: Maximum allowed pattern placement error relative to alignment marks in nanometers. Critical for layer-to-layer overlay accuracy. Typical range 2-10nm.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the mask was retired from production due to reaching usage threshold, excessive defects, or process obsolescence. Null if mask is still active.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for mask retirement: usage limit reached, defect limit exceeded, pattern revision required, process obsolescence, physical damage, or lost/missing.

attributes.name: usage_retirement_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative usage count allowed before mask must be retired from production. Defined per technology node and mask type to ensure yield protection.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor warranty for this mask expires. After this date, repair or replacement costs are borne by the FAB.

products.name: technology_node

SSOT for node-level process and product classification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this technology node record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: design_rule_complexity
attributes.description: Complexity level of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) rules required for this node. Higher complexity nodes require more sophisticated Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) and restricted design rules.

attributes.name: dfm_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Design for Manufacturability (DFM) checks and optimizations are mandatory for designs targeting this node. True for advanced nodes requiring OPC, dummy fill, and restricted design rules.

attributes.name: dft_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Design for Testability (DFT) structures (scan chains, BIST, ATPG patterns) are required for designs on this node. Ensures adequate test coverage for quality assurance.

attributes.name: ear_classification
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) under US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) for this technology node. Determines export licensing requirements to restricted countries.

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when the technology node was officially announced for end-of-life phase-out. Triggers Product Change Notification (PCN) and Last Time Buy (LTB) processes for customers.

attributes.name: iatf16949_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Automotive Task Force (IATF) 16949 Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this technology node is certified under IATF 16949 Automotive Quality Management standards, required for automotive-grade semiconductor production.

attributes.name: mask_set_cost_usd
attributes.description: Cost of a full photomask set for this technology node in US dollars. Significant cost driver for advanced nodes using EUV lithography. Business-confidential pricing data.

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Total number of metal interconnect layers available in the Back End of Line (BEOL) stack for this technology node. Typically ranges from 6 to 15+ layers depending on node complexity.

attributes.name: minimum_feature_size_nm
attributes.description: The smallest feature dimension that can be reliably manufactured in this technology node, measured in nanometers. Critical dimension for lithography and patterning capability.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this technology node record. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code used to uniquely identify the technology node in manufacturing execution systems and product lifecycle management systems.

attributes.name: node_generation
attributes.description: Generation classification of the node (e.g., Leading Edge, Mature, Legacy). Indicates the relative maturity and market positioning of the process technology.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the technology node (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 14nm, 28nm, 65nm, 90nm). Industry-standard designation for the process generation.

attributes.name: nre_cost_estimate_usd
attributes.description: Estimated Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) cost in US dollars for a typical design tapeout on this technology node. Includes mask set costs, design services, and qualification expenses. Business-confidential pricing data.

attributes.name: power_performance_area_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative or quantitative assessment of the node's Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) characteristics relative to prior generations. Critical metric for competitive positioning.

attributes.name: process_flow_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the manufacturing process flow (sequence of FEOL, MOL, BEOL steps) defined for this technology node. Tracks process recipe evolution and engineering changes.

attributes.name: production_readiness_date
attributes.description: Date when the technology node was certified as production-ready and available for high-volume manufacturing (HVM). Null if still in development or qualification.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the technology node. Development: R&D phase. Qualification: undergoing reliability and yield validation. Qualified: approved for production. Production: active manufacturing. Mature: stable high-volume. EOL (End of Life): phase-out planned.

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemicals and materials used in this technology node comply with EU REACH Regulation for chemical safety and substance registration.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing process for this technology node complies with EU RoHS Directive restrictions on hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, etc.).

attributes.name: supported_application_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of target application domains optimized for this node (e.g., Mobile, Automotive, AI/ML, IoT, High-Performance Computing, Networking). Guides product design-in decisions.

attributes.name: target_yield_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage of good dies per wafer for this technology node at maturity. Key performance indicator for manufacturing efficiency and cost competitiveness.

attributes.name: transistor_architecture
attributes.description: Type of transistor structure used in this technology node. Planar for older nodes, FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor) for 22nm-7nm, GAA (Gate All Around) for 3nm and below.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Standard wafer diameter supported by this technology node, typically 200mm (8-inch) or 300mm (12-inch). Determines fab equipment compatibility and die yield economics.

products.name: fab_yield_record

SSOT for FAB inline yield data distinct from final test yield (owned by test domain) and distinct from SPC/metrology analysis (owned by quality domain).

products.name: lot_mask_exposure
products.description: This association product represents the Exposure Event between a photomask (reticle) and a fabrication wafer lot. It captures each instance where a specific photomask was used to expose a specific wafer lot at a specific process layer step. Each record links one photomask to one fabrication_wafer_lot with attributes — layer_name, exposure_count, exposure_timestamp, lot_sequence_number — that exist only in the context of this specific mask-lot exposure event and are essential for yield management, mask maintenance scheduling, and lot genealogy traceability.. Existence Justification: In semiconductor FAB operations, a photomask (reticle) is used to expose multiple wafer lots across its operational lifetime, and a single wafer lot requires multiple photomasks — one per process layer (POLY, METAL1, VIA, etc.) — as it progresses through FEOL, MOL, and BEOL lithography steps. The MES system actively tracks each mask-to-lot exposure event as an operational record for yield management, mask maintenance scheduling, and lot genealogy. This is not an analytical correlation; FAB engineers and process integration teams actively create, query, and manage these exposure records as part of daily operations.

attributes.name: layer_name

Belongs to the exposure event because the same mask may be used at the same layer across many lots, and the same lot passes through many layers with different masks.

products.name: ip_core
products.description: Master catalog of reusable Intellectual Property (IP) cores available for integration into IC designs. Tracks IP type (hard macro, soft IP, firm IP), function category (CPU, GPU, NPU, SerDes, PHY, memory controller, analog, RF), process node compatibility matrix, PPA characterization data, licensing terms and royalty structure, version history, silicon-proven status, EDA tool compatibility, and compliance with industry interface standards (AMBA, PCIe, USB). Sourced from internal IP library and third-party vendors (ARM, Synopsys DesignWare, Cadence Tensilica). SSOT for IP core definitions used across design projects.

attributes.name: ip_core_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each IP core record in the master catalog. Primary key for the ip_core data product.

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.pdk. Business justification: An IP core is defined for a specific Process Design Kit; linking ip_core to pdk eliminates redundant version fields and enables direct lookup of process details.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: IP core licensing vendor relationship; needed for royalty tracking, compliance, and supplier risk assessment.

attributes.name: area_um2
attributes.description: Physical silicon area occupied by the IP core in square micrometers (µm²) for the characterized process node. Part of the PPA characterization data used for die size estimation and floorplanning in Cadence Innovus.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the IP core in the internal IP library and vendor catalogs (e.g., ARM Cortex-A55, SNPS-PCIE-GEN5). Used as the business key across EDA tool flows, PLM, and design project references.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP core record was first created in the master catalog (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data governance and lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: datasheet_url
attributes.description: URL link to the official IP core datasheet or technical reference manual stored in the PLM document management system or vendor portal. Provides design teams with access to integration guidelines, timing specifications, and interface documentation.

attributes.name: design_ip_core_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the IP core as used in design documentation, EDA tool libraries, and vendor datasheets (e.g., 'Cortex-A55 CPU Cluster', 'DesignWare PCIe Gen5 Controller').

attributes.name: dfm_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP core has passed Design for Manufacturability (DFM) rule checks for the target process node (True = DFM-compliant; False = DFM issues present or not checked). DFM compliance reduces yield risk during wafer fabrication.

attributes.name: dft_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP core includes Design for Testability (DFT) structures (scan chains, BIST, boundary scan) compliant with the project's DFT architecture (True = DFT-compliant; False = not compliant or not applicable). Affects ATPG test coverage and ATE test time.

attributes.name: eda_tool_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EDA tools and versions with which this IP core has been validated (e.g., 'Cadence Virtuoso 23.1, Synopsys DC 2023.03, Cadence Innovus 22.1'). Ensures design teams select compatible tool versions for integration.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) / ITAR Classification
attributes.description: Export control classification of the IP core under US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) or International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Determines licensing requirements for cross-border IP transfers and design collaboration with foreign nationals. EAR99 = no license required; ECCN codes require BIS license review; ITAR_controlled = State Dept. license required.

tag_set.value: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) / ITAR Classification

attributes.name: foundry_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of semiconductor foundries for which this IP core has been qualified and is available (e.g., 'TSMC, Samsung, GlobalFoundries'). Determines which fabrication facilities can manufacture designs incorporating this IP.

attributes.name: function_category
attributes.description: Functional classification of the IP core indicating its primary design purpose (e.g., CPU, GPU, NPU, SerDes, PHY, memory_controller, analog, RF, security, interconnect, IO). Used for IP portfolio management and design-in selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CPU|GPU|NPU|SerDes|PHY|memory_controller|analog|RF|security|interconnect|IO|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: functional_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of the IP core's functionality, architecture, and key features as documented in the IP datasheet. Provides design engineers with the information needed to evaluate IP suitability for a given SoC design.

attributes.name: gate_count
attributes.description: Equivalent gate count of the IP core representing its logic complexity, expressed in number of 2-input NAND gate equivalents. Used for die area estimation, synthesis resource planning, and complexity benchmarking in Synopsys Design Compiler.

attributes.name: gds_available
attributes.business_glossary_term: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) Layout Availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether a GDSII (Graphic Data System II) physical layout file is available for this IP core (True = GDSII provided; False = not available). GDSII availability is required for hard macro integration and tapeout submission.

tag_set.value: Graphic Data System II (GDSII) Layout Availability

attributes.name: interface_standard
attributes.description: Industry interface protocol standards supported by this IP core (e.g., AMBA AXI4, PCIe Gen5, USB 3.2, DDR5, MIPI CSI-2). Ensures interoperability with SoC interconnect fabric and system-level integration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AMBA_AXI4|PCIe_Gen5|USB3.2|DDR5|MIPI_CSI2|Ethernet|CAN|I2C|SPI|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ip_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IP core by its delivery form: hard_macro (fixed physical layout, process-specific GDS), soft_ip (synthesizable RTL, process-portable), or firm_ip (partially optimized netlist, semi-portable). Determines integration methodology and EDA tool flow requirements.

attributes.name: lef_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Library Exchange Format (LEF) abstract view is available for this IP core (True = LEF provided; False = not available). LEF files are required for place-and-route integration in Cadence Innovus and Synopsys IC Compiler.

attributes.name: license_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intellectual Property (IP) Core License Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date on which the IP core license agreement expires or must be renewed. Null for perpetual licenses. Critical for license renewal planning and ensuring design projects do not use expired IP licenses.

tag_set.value: Intellectual Property (IP) Core License Expiry Date

attributes.name: license_fee_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intellectual Property (IP) Core License Fee USD
attributes.description: One-time or annual license fee paid to the IP vendor in US Dollars (USD). Represents the NRE or access cost component of the IP licensing agreement. Null for open-source or internally developed IP.

tag_set.value: Intellectual Property (IP) Core License Fee USD

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Type of licensing arrangement governing use of this IP core: perpetual (one-time fee, unlimited use), subscription (time-limited access), royalty_bearing (per-unit royalty on shipped products), royalty_free (no per-unit royalty after license fee), open_source (governed by open-source license terms). Drives financial planning and legal compliance.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the IP core in the catalog: active (available for new designs), deprecated (supported but not recommended for new designs), obsolete (no longer supported), under_development (not yet released), qualification (in silicon validation). Drives IP selection eligibility and EOL planning.

attributes.name: max_frequency_mhz
attributes.description: Maximum achievable operating frequency of the IP core in megahertz (MHz) at the characterized process corner (typical/worst-case) for the target process node. Part of the PPA characterization data used for timing closure planning in Synopsys Design Compiler and PrimeTime.

attributes.name: mpw_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP core is eligible for inclusion in Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle runs for cost-effective silicon validation (True = MPW eligible; False = not eligible, e.g., due to NDA restrictions or hard macro size constraints).

attributes.name: nda_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) must be in place before design teams can access the IP core documentation, RTL source, or GDSII files (True = NDA required; False = no NDA required). Governs IP access control and legal compliance.

attributes.name: power_uw
attributes.description: Characterized typical power consumption of the IP core in microwatts (µW) at the nominal operating voltage and frequency for the target process node. Part of the Power-Performance-Area (PPA) characterization data used for SoC power budget analysis.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of the IP core against the target process node and foundry: not_started, in_progress (characterization underway), qualified (passed all qualification criteria), failed (qualification failed, remediation required). Distinct from silicon_proven status.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the IP core was officially released and made available for design-in use in the internal IP library or vendor catalog. Used for version history tracking and design project planning.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP core and its associated physical implementation materials comply with the EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances (True = RoHS compliant; False = non-compliant or not assessed). Required for products sold in the EU market.

attributes.name: royalty_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intellectual Property (IP) Core Royalty Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Per-unit royalty rate expressed as a percentage of the net selling price of the end product incorporating this IP core. Applicable only for royalty_bearing license types. Used for royalty accrual and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA.

tag_set.value: Intellectual Property (IP) Core Royalty Rate Percentage

attributes.name: rtl_language
attributes.business_glossary_term: Register Transfer Level (RTL) Hardware Description Language
attributes.description: Hardware description language used for the RTL source code of the IP core (Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, or mixed). Relevant only for soft IP and firm IP types. Determines EDA tool compatibility and synthesis flow requirements.

tag_set.value: Register Transfer Level (RTL) Hardware Description Language

attributes.name: scan_coverage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of internal logic nodes covered by scan-based DFT test structures, as reported by ATPG tools. Higher coverage reduces DPPM risk. Null if DFT is not applicable (e.g., analog IP).

attributes.name: silicon_proven
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP core has been successfully validated in a fabricated silicon device (True = silicon-proven; False = simulation-only or pre-silicon). Silicon-proven status is a critical risk factor in IP selection for production designs.

attributes.name: silicon_proven_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IP core achieved silicon-proven status through successful tape-out and functional validation in fabricated silicon. Null if not yet silicon-proven.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP core originates from the internal IP development team, a third-party vendor (e.g., ARM, Synopsys DesignWare, Cadence Tensilica), or an open-source library. Determines licensing obligations, support model, and NRE cost applicability.

attributes.name: support_tier
attributes.description: Level of technical support available for this IP core: standard (community/documentation support), premium (dedicated FAE support with SLA), end_of_support (no active support, use at own risk). Influences design-in risk assessment and vendor engagement planning.

attributes.name: timing_model_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether Liberty (.lib) timing models are available for this IP core for static timing analysis (True = Liberty models provided; False = not available). Required for timing closure analysis in Synopsys PrimeTime and Cadence Tempus.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP core record was most recently modified in the master catalog (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party IP vendor or licensor (e.g., ARM Holdings, Synopsys, Cadence Design Systems, CEVA). Null for internally developed IP cores. Used for vendor management, license tracking, and procurement.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the IP core release following semantic versioning (e.g., 2.1.0, r0p4). Tracks revision history and ensures design projects reference the correct IP release.

products.name: pdk
products.description: Process Design Kit (PDK) master record defining the foundry-specific design rules, device models, standard cell libraries, and technology files required for IC design at a given process node. Captures PDK version, foundry name, process node (e.g., 3nm, 5nm, 7nm), SPICE model sets, DRC/LVS rule decks, layer stack definitions, and EDA tool compatibility matrix. SSOT for PDK versioning used in Cadence Virtuoso and Synopsys Design Compiler flows.

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the PDK master record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: product_process_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.process_node. Business justification: Ensures alignment of PDKs with official process‑node definitions for compliance, cost, and yield analysis in engineering reports.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: PDK procurement and NDA management: design teams must track which supplier delivers each PDK version for license compliance, NDA enforcement, and supplier qualification audits. foundry_name is a denor

attributes.name: agile_plm_part_number
attributes.description: Part number assigned to this PDK in Oracle Agile PLM for product data and change management. Used to track PDK-related Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and Product Change Notifications (PCNs).

attributes.name: checksum_sha256
attributes.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the PDK distribution archive. Used to verify PDK file integrity after download or transfer, ensuring no corruption or unauthorized modification of foundry-provided design rule files.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this PDK release, as assigned by the foundry or internal PDK management team (e.g., TSMC_N5_PDK_2023Q4). Used as the business-facing identifier in Cadence Virtuoso and Synopsys Design Compiler tool configurations.

attributes.name: deprecation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PDK version was deprecated and superseded by a newer release. Designs in progress must migrate to the active version by this date. Null if the PDK is still active.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the PDK, including key features, intended use cases, known limitations, and any special design guidelines. Provides context for design engineers selecting the appropriate PDK for a new IC design project.

attributes.name: dft_rule_deck_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design for Testability (DFT) Rule Deck Version
attributes.description: Version of the Design for Testability (DFT) rule deck included in this PDK. DFT rules govern scan chain insertion, ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) compatibility, and boundary scan requirements for post-fabrication testing.

tag_set.value: Design for Testability (DFT) Rule Deck Version

attributes.name: drc_rule_deck_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Rule Check (DRC) Rule Deck Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Design Rule Check (DRC) rule deck included in this PDK. The DRC rule deck enforces foundry-mandated physical design rules to ensure manufacturability. Used in Cadence Innovus and KLA ICOS inspection correlation.

tag_set.value: Design Rule Check (DRC) Rule Deck Version

attributes.name: eda_tool_compatibility
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Design Automation (EDA) Tool Compatibility Matrix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or reference identifier describing the EDA tool versions certified for use with this PDK (e.g., 'Cadence Virtuoso 23.1, Synopsys IC Compiler II 2023.03, Mentor Calibre 2023.1'). Ensures design teams use validated tool-PDK combinations for tapeout sign-off.

tag_set.value: Electronic Design Automation (EDA) Tool Compatibility Matrix

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification of this PDK under US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) or ITAR. Determines which countries and entities may receive this PDK. Critical for compliance with BIS/EAR and CHIPS Act requirements.

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: Canonical file system or object storage path to the PDK installation directory or archive (e.g., '/pdk/tsmc/n5/v1.3.2' or 's3://pdk-repo/tsmc/n5/v1.3.2'). Used by EDA tool setup scripts to locate PDK assets in Cadence Virtuoso and Synopsys Design Compiler environments.

attributes.name: gds_format
attributes.description: Layout data format supported by this PDK for tapeout submission to the foundry. GDSII (Graphic Data System II) is the legacy industry standard; OASIS is the modern compressed alternative. Determines the final tapeout file format.

attributes.name: io_library_name
attributes.description: Name of the I/O pad cell library included in this PDK, providing ESD-protected interface cells for chip-to-package signal routing. Required for full-chip physical design and package co-design.

attributes.name: ip_library_version
attributes.description: Version of the foundry-provided hard IP library (e.g., PLLs, SerDes, PHYs) bundled with this PDK. IP cores are pre-characterized and validated for the specific process node.

attributes.name: layer_stack_definition
attributes.description: Identifier or reference name for the metal layer stack definition included in this PDK, specifying the number of metal layers, dielectric materials, and interconnect hierarchy (FEOL/MOL/BEOL). Governs routing resources available to physical design tools.

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Type of licensing agreement under which this PDK is distributed to design teams. 'foundry_standard' = included with foundry engagement; 'nre_included' = bundled with NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) agreement; 'subscription' = annual license fee; 'evaluation' = time-limited trial.

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Primary lithography technology used in this process node as reflected in the PDK design rules. EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet) is used for leading-edge nodes (≤7nm); DUV (Deep Ultraviolet) with multi-patterning for older nodes. Impacts mask cost and design rule complexity.

attributes.name: lvs_rule_deck_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Rule Deck Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) rule deck included in this PDK. LVS verifies that the physical layout matches the circuit schematic. Mandatory for tapeout sign-off in Cadence Virtuoso flows.

tag_set.value: Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Rule Deck Version

attributes.name: max_supply_voltage_v
attributes.description: Maximum operating supply voltage (Vdd) in volts supported by this process node as defined in the PDK. Exceeding this value risks device reliability and oxide breakdown.

attributes.name: memory_compiler_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PDK includes or is compatible with a foundry-provided memory compiler for generating SRAM, ROM, or register file macros. True = memory compiler available; False = memory macros must be sourced separately.

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Total number of metal interconnect layers defined in the PDK layer stack. Determines routing density, signal integrity characteristics, and manufacturing cost. Typical values range from 6 to 20+ for advanced nodes.

attributes.name: min_supply_voltage_v
attributes.description: Minimum operating supply voltage (Vdd) in volts supported by this process node as defined in the PDK. Used for low-power design optimization and multi-voltage domain planning.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PDK version is qualified and approved for use in Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle runs, enabling cost-shared prototyping across multiple design projects on a single wafer.

attributes.name: name
